timing: Source/mathematical audit, not a new empirical efficacy experiment. Seven known-answer unit fixtures ran before aggregate receipt; no optimization or architecture selection.
native_collision: Choose a direction in the common nullspace of private encoder and independent frozen target projection; perturb two slots oppositely. All shared/private/replacement/content outputs collide while a permutation-invariant native second moment changes.
rank_scope: Ambient slot tensor, not actual patient manifold or predictive harm. Rank bound is(K-1)*rank(B)+rank([A;B]); identical-slot manifold is a counter-control.
hsic_control: Exactly enumerate16 hypothetical patient states with one shared bit present in private within-slot cross covariance but absent from coordinate first/second moments. Exercise actual source summary_hsic with default64/192 dimensions and8 slots.
residual_controls: Ordinary residual cancellation; bounded affine residual with exact SVD norm and analytic inverse; zero-gain/zero-branch gradient; orthogonal encode/decode identity with no task gradient; orthogonal full-slot geometry preservation and lossy shared pooling.
hook_control: Use actual SlotPluginHost on a declared generated permutation-invariant moment predictor. This predictor is not the protected native survival head and not a patient checkpoint.
acceptance: Default ambient rank<=1600 of2048, source collision within1e-12, HSIC summary near0 despite exact full-private MI=ln2, bounded inverse error<1e-8 and min singular >=1-q, ordinary residual can cancel.
limits: Fixed source parameters and known generated states; does not prove real patient information loss, shared/private biological semantics, stable training or prediction improvement. No claim that finite power iterations certify a norm upper bound.
